$description: Contents of markers.json: the persisted marker state. Field-for-field mirror of specs/markers/state.qnt with model ints realized as op-log hex strings.

at.description: Current position; "0" is the model's unset sentinel. Ids pass through verbatim — the schema judges shape, never id validity.

b.description: The redo bound: the pair count when the undone count was last set from nothing-undone. Redo is valid only while the pair count equals it (D15b); the u <= b <= length rule is cross-field and lives with the model invariants and the marker guards.

u.description: 0 means nothing undone, else the number of operations undone.

title: Marker file
